svg.title: Two modulus transformations, two different graphs
svg.desc: Side-by-side plots of absolute value of f and f of absolute x, where f=x^2−3x−10. They have different intercepts and roots.

g.text: Two modulus transformations, two different graphs
Pearson Edexcel International A Level Mathematics • Functions
Reflect negative parts for |f(x)|; mirror the right half for f(|x|).
Roots −2 and 5; the dip reflects above the x-axis.
Even graph; roots are −5 and 5; minimums at ±1.5.
For f(x)=x²−3x−10, y=|f(x)| has y-intercept 10; y=f(|x|) has y-intercept −10.
